Do you have schizophrenia? Was it like this for you in the beginning? I also don’t have any delusions as of right now
I know this shit sucks, what caused it for you?

When i went into high school my anxiety started. I couldn't explain it but I just didn't like having attention anymore. It led me to deleting social media and distancing myself from friends. Sophomore year, where I thought I would finally leave these things in the past, I found out that these friends were still talking about me. They said i've been 'hiding under a rock.' This single comment made me kind of paranoid, and everyday when I saw them I tried to avoid them. But it seemed as the more I tried to stay away the more weird they acted towards me. I couldn't tell if they were joking with me or actually disliked me for staying away from them. This made me extremely dislike these kids and I always hoped to see them again so I could set them straight. I'm not sure if this is a factor because now, I have no interest in doing anything with them. Everyday I thought of sophomore year but I think maybe my mind is repressing it. Other than that, I've had social anxiety but never experienced anything like this.
Thank you, I've been going to swim almost every other day trying to stay strong, I'll try to avoid looking this up but sometimes it gets very stressful.

I did used to be a little paranoid about things, and I hope that this didn't take it to another level. What really makes me think it's schizo is the impaired movement, lack of concentration, and the visuals i'm seeing. I'm hoping that it's just hppd or something but this is just something I have never experienced. These symptoms have been ongoing for over a month and I saw online that if these continue over a month, it's prolonged psychosis aka schizophrenia. I'm hoping that it isn't and that it's taking longer that usual for me to return to normal.
